articles.text: JIĀNG TÓNGZHÌ: Nuòwǎkè Nǚshì! Nín zǎo.
COMRADE JIĀNG: Miss Novak! Good morning.
NUÒWǍKÈ NǙSHÌ: Zǎo. Jiāng Tóngzhì! Nín hǎo.
MISS NOVAK: Good morning. Comrade Jiāng! How are you.
JIĀNG TÓNGZHÌ: Wǒ hěn hǎo. Qǐngwèn, nǐ zhù zai něige fàndiàn?
COMRADE JIĀNG: I'm very well. May I ask, which hotel are you staying at?
NUÒWǍKÈ NǙSHÌ: Wǒ zhù zai Běijīng Fàndiàn. Nǐ zhù zai zhèige fàndiàn ma?
MISS NOVAK: I'm staying at the Běijīng Hotel. Are you staying at this hotel?
JIĀNG TÓNGZHÌ: Bù, wǒ bù zhù zai zhèige fàndiàn. Wǒ zhù zai Mínzú Fàndiàn.
COMRADE JIĀNG: No, I'm not staying at this hotel. I'm staying at the Nationalities Hotel.
NUÒWǍKÈ NǙSHÌ: Qǐngwèn, něiwèi shi Gāo Tóngzhì?
MISS NOVAK: May I ask, which one is Comrade Gāo?
JIĀNG TÓNGZHÌ: Nèiwèi shi Gāo Tóngzhì. Nǐ shi Měiguo nǎrde rén?
COMRADE JIĀNG: That one is Comrade Gāo. Where are you from in America?
NUÒWǍKÈ NǙSHÌ: Wǒ shi Jiāzhōu Jiùjīnshān rén. Xièxie.
MISS NOVAK: I'm from San Francisco, California. Thank you.
